Definition: properly, to shear off; but used only in the (figuratively) sense of passing rapidly
BiblicalUsage: gûwz is how Scripture says to pass rapidly, to fly away. In Psalm 90:10, the text says "for it is soon cut off."
TheologicalSignificance: I take gûwz as it stands: to pass rapidly, to fly away.
RelatedEvents: The Quail and the Craving at Kibroth-hattaavah
